name: CMS Watchman
author: gits229

sections.description:
CMS Watchman is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to enhance website security by monitoring and reporting vulnerabilities. It integrates seamlessly with the Watchman.bj platform to provide real-time insights, advanced analytics, and actionable recommendations to protect your website against emerging threats.

Key Features:

  • Real-time vulnerability detection: Monitors WordPress core, plugins, and themes for known issues.
  • Advanced reporting: Integration with Watchman.bj for detailed analytics and summaries.
  • User-friendly interface: Intuitive dashboard with alerts and action recommendations.
  • Automated notifications: Receive email alerts for critical security issues.
  • Scheduled reports: Automatically generates weekly security reports and allows manual report generation.
  • Regular updates: Ensures compatibility with the latest WordPress versions.

Whether you’re managing a personal blog or a complex multi-site installation, CMS Watchman empowers you with the tools and insights needed to maintain a secure WordPress environment.

External Services

This plugin connects to the “CMS Watchman” API to monitor installed plugins and themes for known vulnerabilities.

The following data is sent to the external service when the plugin is activated and when plugin/theme information is updated:
– Plugin and theme names
– Plugin and theme versions
– WordPress version
– Website URL (to send notifications about vulnerabilities)

This data is sent to the CMS Watchman API at: https://cms.api.watchman.bj/api/v1/

This service helps administrators stay informed about potential security risks.

CMS Watchman Privacy Policy: https://www.watchman.bj/docs/privacy-policy
CMS Watchman Terms of Service: https://www.watchman.bj/docs/terms-conditions
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions to set up and connect the plugin to your Watchman.bj account for enhanced reporting.
sections.faq:
What does CMS Watchman do?

CMS Watchman monitors WordPress sites for vulnerabilities in the core, plugins, and themes. It integrates with the Watchman.bj platform to provide advanced analytics and actionable recommendations.

How does the report generation work?

The plugin generates weekly security reports automatically. You can also manually generate reports through the plugin’s settings whenever needed.

Is CMS Watchman compatible with all WordPress versions?

CMS Watchman is regularly updated to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress versions. Check the “Tested up to” section above for more details.

How do I connect CMS Watchman to the Watchman.bj platform?

After activating the plugin, follow the setup wizard to connect your site to the Watchman.bj platform. The process is seamless and requires minimal configuration.

Will CMS Watchman slow down my website?

No. CMS Watchman is optimized to use minimal server resources, ensuring it runs efficiently without affecting your site’s performance.
